description: Run a policy-rate spread what-if scenario for an FX pair and estimate directional spot impact using an explicit heuristic elasticity assumption. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: requires an FXMacroData API key; an anonymous call returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CNH, CNY, DKK, EUR, GBP, HUF, ILS, JPY, KRW, MYR, NGN, NOK, NZD, PEN, SEK, THB, TWD, USD.

elasticity_per_100bps.description: Heuristic percent change in FX spot for a 100 bps spread change. Used as a scenario assumption, not a forecast guarantee.

policy_shock_bps.description: Optional alias for shock_bps for compatibility with host-side app payloads.

quote.description: Quote currency, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CNH, CNY, DKK, EUR, GBP, HUF, ILS, JPY, KRW, MYR, NGN, NOK, NZD, PEN, SEK, THB, TWD, USD.

shock_bps.description: Policy shock size in basis points (100 bps = 1.00 percentage point).

shock_leg.description: Which leg receives the policy shock: base or quote.
